## RCA confirmation and disposition

Step 0: duplicate sweep found prior closed duplicate `linty-sunshiny-gull` / `94a3-1323-3497-4f59`, whose fix is already merged on current `origin/main`. Report floor from this ticket's `created_at` is `05be3a4dc6e48d982006cc5532904cd17add41eb`; worktree HEAD is current `origin/main` (`1299d9deb6da82708bf694e19572ef8579664f34`).

Confirmed RCA on current `origin/main`: plan material is a single composite hash over basis keys from `src/rebar/llm/plan_review/material_diff.py` (`ticket_id`, normalized `description`, `file_impact`, `children`, plus conditional `file_impact_scope`) and `pass1.material_fingerprint()` delegates to that basis. Checkbox state is normalized out by `normalize_checkbox_state`, so a tick-only AC edit is attestation-safe; local reproduction printed equal hashes for unticked vs ticked descriptions. The pre-fix failure was diagnostic: stale-material reasons used a fixed/fictional list (`description/AC/file_impact/children`) rather than signed per-component material.

Defect origin: commit `66f0220d747f6eda5cd15986d4c8659bbf88096a` (epic `dark-acme-lumen`, `4702-a55c-7aeb-445a`) introduced kind-keyed attestations and `compute_validity`, including the fixed stale-material wording. The plan itself described the material as `description/AC/file_impact/children`, so this is attributed as `plan_defect` caused by `dark-acme-lumen`.

Fix/verification: existing merged Gerrit change 1434 (`4b5a7bcd4adf744d96ba98fcd953afa3c37d780e`, ticket `94a3-1323-3497-4f59`) adds additive `material-part:` manifest lines, component-wise explanation, and the refusal-surface parity updates. RED oracle on pre-fix parent `34998a2ca835...` failed because the stale completion-material reason did not contain `file_impact`; current targeted suite passes: `pytest tests/unit/plan_review/test_94a3_material_diff.py tests/unit/test_compute_validity.py tests/unit/test_legacy_material_grandfather_96d1.py tests/unit/test_attestation_invalidation.py tests/unit/test_plan_material_pins.py -q` => 113 passed. Sandboxed mutation restoring the old completion-verifier stale-material message returned RED (12 failures in the material-diff test file). Full `pytest tests/unit tests/integration -q` reached one unrelated environment failure: `tests/integration/test_reconcile_live_e2e.py::test_delete_permission_probe` cannot create a Jira item because ACLI is not authenticated.

Step 7 sweep: `git grep` over `src/rebar` finds no remaining `description/AC/file_impact/children` runtime literal. `compute_validity` stale-material uses `explain_material_change`; `claim_gate_check` forwards validity reasons and names both unsigned remedies; `generation.py` and `resign.py` name own/dependency material drift; `completion_child_gate.py` forwards the child signature reason; `_cli/_llm_commands.py` special-cases `plan_review_sign_aborted` store-read-failure. `stale-code`/`stale-head` and cryptographic op-cert/signing errors already name their differing files/SHAs/keys and were correctly left alone.
